parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe how Christians might observe Advent, before the Christmas festival.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the importance of Good Friday for Christians.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Too many Christian festivals are ignored today.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Give an account of what happens at a believer’s baptism.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain why Christians might think it is important to have a religious ritual when a person
becomes committed to being a Christian.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Christians should not be afraid of death.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the features of Rome which make it a place of pilgrimage for Christians.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why Easter is a time when Christians might choose to go on pilgrimage.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Christians should not combine holidays with pilgrimages.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer. 
Section B – Islam
If you have chosen this section answer all of the parts in two of the questions.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the observance of the fast during Ramadan.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain the reasons there might be for not fasting during Ramadan and the ways compensation
might be made for this.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Fasting only benefits the person who is doing it.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Islam in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Give an account of:

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: the mahr (dowry) and

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: the roles of witnesses at a Muslim wedding.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why many Muslim marriages are arranged marriages.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘If necessary, Muslims should migrate to other countries to preserve their religious traditions.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Islam in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe how Shariah (law) is put into practice.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the benefits to Muslims of belonging to a strong religious community.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘In Islam it is equally important to help both the local and international community.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Islam in your answer.

Section C – Judaism
If you have chosen this section answer all of the parts in two of the questions.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe how Jews keep alive the memory of the Temple in their festivals.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain why the Holocaust Memorial in Jerusalem (Yad Vashem) is so significant to many
Jews.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Remembering the past makes Judaism stronger.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Judaism in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe Jewish funeral rites.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why the chevra kaddisha is an important part of the Jewish community.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘People should be allowed to mourn the dead in their own way.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Judaism in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe two ways in which some Jews keep themselves separate from others.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why, in Judaism, helping the disadvantaged is the responsibility of the whole community.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Obeying the mitzvot will not bring about a perfect world.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Judaism in your answer.
